lyrics:
[Intro - Male Solo]
ମତେ ସପନ୍ ଦେଖ୍‌ବାକେ ମନା ନାଇଁ,
ମଝି ବାଟେ ହଜିଯିବାକେ ବି ମନା ନାଇଁ।
ଧ୍ରୁବତାରା ବାଟ୍ ଦେଖେଇଦେବା।

[Verse 1 - Male Solo]
ସାଉଁଟି... ସାଉଁଟି...
ସଂସାର୍‌କେ ଜାବ୍‌ଡ଼ି ଧରିଛେଁ—
ଜୁଡ଼ିଦେବାର୍ ଆଶାନେ,
ସଜେଇଦେବାର୍ ଆଶାନେ।

[Verse 2 - Male Solo]
କୁମ୍ଭାର୍ ମୁଇଁ।

ଗଢ଼ିଦେବାର୍ ସିଖିଛେଁ,
ରଙ୍ଗ୍ ଲଗେଇ,
ତୋର୍ ମୁହେଁ ହସ୍ ବୁନ୍‌ବାର୍ ସିଖିଛେଁ।

[Chorus - Male Lead]
ମତେ ସପନ୍ ଦେଖ୍‌ବାକେ ମନା ନାଇଁ,
ମଝି ବାଟେ ହଜିଯିବାକେ ବି ମନା ନାଇଁ।
ଧ୍ରୁବତାରା ବାଟ୍ ଦେଖେଇଦେବା।

[Bridge - Male Lead, Soft Female Responses]
ଆ, ପାହାଡ଼୍ ଚଢ଼୍‌ମା।
ଆ, ଜନ୍ ଦେଖ୍‌ମା।
ବାଦଲ୍ ସାଙ୍ଗେ କାନ୍ଧ୍ ମିଲେଇ,
ବର୍ଷା ହେଇ ଝର୍‌ବାର୍ ମନ୍ତର୍ ସିଖ୍‌ମା।

[Final Chorus - Male and Female Duet]
ମତେ ସପନ୍ ଦେଖ୍‌ବାକେ ମନା ନାଇଁ।
ତୋର୍ ସପନ୍‌କେ ମୋର୍ ସପନ୍‌ନେ
ଗୁଁଥିଦେବାକେ ବି ମନା ନାଇଁ।

[Soft Outro - Both Voices]
ତୋର୍ ସପନ୍‌କେ ମୋର୍ ସପନ୍‌ନେ...
ଗୁଁଥିଦେବାକେ ବି ମନା ନାଇଁ।

settings.vocal_gender: Unselected; male lead and female responses specified in lyrics/style

title: ମତେ ସପନ୍ ଦେଖ୍‌ବାକେ ମନା ନାଇଁ — Soft Duet
style: Warm youthful male solo with soft female answering phrases, tender close-harmony duet at the end. Male sings the opening, all verses and first chorus. Female enters softly only at the mountain-and-moon invitation, offering brief replies behind the lead. Keep her delicate and supportive until the final refrain, when both voices blend intimately. Sambalpuri folk ballad, natural local speech cadence, clear compact endings and short expressive turns. Bamboo flute, lightly played dhol, soft bass and quiet acoustic guitar; gently lilting pulse. Calm soulful joy, affection and wonder. Spacious unhurried phrasing, sparse opening, gradually add warmth without speeding up. Distinct breath between the repeated gathering phrases; full pause after the potter declaration, soft instruments sustaining beneath. Use only supplied lyric words. Peaceful hopeful outro. No female-led verse, alternating lead verses, busy vocal counterpoint, driving beat, mournful delivery or dramatic crescendo.
changes: Restore male solo verses and first chorus, soft female answering phrases only at invitation, close-harmony duet at end
author_direction: male solo with soft female answering phrases, tender close-harmony duet at the end
